convert_rgb_to_ycbcr: convert an RGB tensor to YCbCr color space using JPEG conversion coefficients
convert_ycbcr_to_rgb: convert a YCbCr tensor back to RGB color space using JPEG conversion coefficients
compute_psnr: compute the peak signal-to-noise ratio between two image tensors with optional masking
convert_tensor_to_numpy_array: convert a PyTorch image tensor to a numpy uint8 array for saving with PIL
apply_gamma_correction: apply gamma correction to linear RGB images using sRGB or Aria-specific conversion
